children.text: Steven founded The Wire Guy Electric in 2017, bringing over 12 years of experience to serve his community as a trusted resource. In his free time, he enjoys cooking, spending time with his fiance Emma and their dog Lulu, watching movies, and doing projects around their home.

Cody has been with The Wire Guy Electric since its start in 2017, working closely with our team to deliver top-notch service. A proud Arizona native, Cody enjoys family time, cooking on his Blackstone, and riding his motorcycle with his wife, Lauren.
Cade has been with us for about 6 years and has been a great addition to our team.
Wade is the newest member of our team, with a background in HVAC and home remodeling. Born and raised in Mesa, Arizona, he enjoys spending time with his wife and family, traveling, and snowboarding.

Emma has been with The Wire Guy for about 3 years and is the friendly voice you’ll hear on the phone. In her free time, she enjoys paddle boarding, cooking, trying new foods, crafting, and spending time with her fiance Steven and their dog Lulu.

Lauren has been with us for about a year, managing all things networking. An Arizona native, she loves living close to family. She and Cody married in September 2023 and are enjoying married life! Lauren enjoys Dr. Pepper, film photography, and sharing good food with Cody.
